in_marathi.name: Durgadas
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Valor
in_marathi.long_meaning: Durgadas हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Durgadas is a compound name composed of two words - 'Durga' and 'Das'. Durga is a feminine form of the goddess Shakti, symbolizing strength, courage, and protection. Das is a masculine suffix that translates to 'servant' or 'slave'. Together, Durgadas represents a valiant warrior who serves and protects.
